list.name: sensor
list.label: Sensor
list.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "wtvb01")
  |> group(columns: ["sensor"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.sensor}))
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"])
list.definition: Sensors with actual wtvb01 data in the last 30 days

list.name: expected_rpm
list.label: Expected RPM
list.query:
import "array"
import "math"

speed = float(v: ${line_speed})
diameter = float(v: ${roll_diameter})
rpm = if speed > 0.0 and diameter > 0.0 then speed / (3.141592653589793 * (diameter / 1000.0)) else 0.0
array.from(rows: [{_value: math.round(x: rpm * 10.0) / 10.0}])
list.definition: Calculated roll speed in revolutions per minute

list.name: expected_frequency
list.label: Expected frequency (Hz)
list.query:

import "math"

diameter = float(v: ${roll_diameter})
rpm = if speed > 0.0 and diameter > 0.0 then speed / (3.141592653589793 * (diameter / 1000.0)) else 0.0
hz = rpm / 60.0
array.from(rows: [{_value: math.round(x: hz * 100.0) / 100.0}])

panels.description: Instantaneous three-axis acceleration from the WTVB01 normal-mode registers.
panels.title: Acceleration

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "wtvb01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor"] =~ /^${sensor:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^acc_[xyz]_g$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.sensor + " · " + (if r._field == "acc_x_g" then "X" else if r._field == "acc_y_g" then "Y" else "Z")}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")

  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["series", "_time"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

targets.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "wtvb01_fft")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor"] =~ /^${sensor:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^(sample_rate_hz|averages)$/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.sensor + " · " + (if r._field == "sample_rate_hz" then "Sample rate, Hz" else "Averaged captures")}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")
